d: We are looking for a creative and technically skilled AI Videographer & Video Editor to join our marketing team. The ideal candidate will have strong videography and video editing skills, a keen eye for visual storytelling, and a genuine passion for exploring emerging AI technologies.

The role involves producing high-quality video content from concept to final delivery, while leveraging AI-powered tools and platforms to enhance creativity, streamline production, and explore innovative approaches to visual content creation. The successful candidate should be proactive in keeping up with the latest AI developments and confident in experimenting with new tools and technologies.
q: li
Bachelor's degree in Film Production, Media, Multimedia, Communications, or a related field.
li
Minimum 2 years of professional experience in videography and video editing.
li
A strong professional portfolio showcasing videography, filming, video editing, and creative production work. Portfolio submission is mandatory.
li
Strong visual sense and understanding of framing, composition, lighting, and color.
li
Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro (or DaVinci Resolve / Final Cut Pro) and Adobe After Effects.
li
Solid knowledge of cameras (mirrorless/cinema), lenses, lighting setups, and production equipment.
li
Strong understanding of pacing, storytelling, sound design, and visual narratives.
li
Hands-on experience with AI tools and platforms for creative production, including Higgsfield, Claude, and other emerging AI solutions.
li
Genuine interest in AI, generative technologies, and upcoming AI trends, with the ability to identify and adopt new tools that improve creative output and production efficiency.
li
Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects, and deliver high-quality work under tight deadlines.
li
Strong communication, collaboration, and teamwork skills.
r: Plan, shoot, and produce video content, including promotional videos, social media content, commercials, corporate videos, and event coverage.
Operate cameras, lenses, gimbals, lighting, and audio equipment to produce high-quality visual content.
Edit footage into polished final videos, including cutting, color grading, sound design, motion graphics, and subtitles.
Adapt content for different platforms and formats, including Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube, and various aspect ratios (9:16, 16:9, and 1:1).
Collaborate with the team on creative concepts, scripts, storyboards, and visual direction.
Manage footage, project files, production timelines, and deliverables while meeting deadlines.
Maintain, organize, and properly handle production equipment.
Explore and implement AI-powered tools and technologies to enhance video production, creative workflows, and content quality.
Stay up to date with emerging AI trends, new platforms, and developments in generative AI, video creation, and creative automation.
